study_title: CRISPR activation and interference screens decode stimulation responses in primary human T cells

study_title: Genome-wide CRISPR Screens in Primary Human T Cells Reveal Key Regulators of Immune Function

screen_title: Integrated four-donor genome-wide CRISPR knockout screen for regulators of TCR-stimulation-dependent proliferation in primary human CD8+ T cells
dirconv: positive LFC indicates enrichment in highly proliferating (dividing) cells; negative LFC indicates depletion from proliferating cells
phdesc: CFSE dye-dilution proliferation of TCR-restimulated CD8+ T cells; cells FACS-sorted into non-proliferating (CFSE-high) and highly proliferating (CFSE-low) populations and sgRNA abundance compared between them

Integrated analysis over four donors (primary and secondary screens).
study_title: Genome-wide CRISPR Screens in Primary Human T Cells Reveal Key Regulators of Immune Function

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR knockout screen for resistance to adenosine A2A receptor-mediated immunosuppression in primary human CD8+ T cells
dirconv: positive enrichment (guides in the proliferating CFSE-low population) indicates increased proliferation / resistance to adenosine suppression
phdesc: Resistance to adenosine A2A receptor-mediated immunosuppression measured as enrichment of sgRNAs in the highly proliferating (CFSE-low) CD8+ T cell population after TCR stimulation in the presence of the A2A agonist CGS-21680 (20 uM), relative to non-proliferating cells

study_title: Genome-wide CRISPR Screens in Primary Human T Cells Reveal Key Regulators of Immune Function

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR knockout screen for resistance to adenosine A2A receptor-mediated immunosuppression in primary human CD8+ T cells
dirconv: positive LFC indicates guide enrichment in the highly proliferating (CFSE-low) population, i.e., increased proliferation
phdesc: T cells labeled with CFSE and restimulated, then FACS-sorted into non-proliferating (CFSE-high) and highly proliferating (CFSE-low) populations; sgRNA enrichment in the proliferating population quantified for the vehicle (stimulation-only) condition
sel: FACS sorting of highly proliferating (CFSE-low) versus non-proliferating (CFSE-high) cells following TCR stimulation, without adenosine agonist (vehicle control)
cult: X-Vivo media with IL-2 at 50 U/mL
adesc: CD8+ T cells were stimulated with plate-bound anti-CD3/CD28 and IL-2, transduced with the Brunello sgRNA lentiviral library, electroporated with Cas9 protein, expanded, then on day 14 CFSE-stained and restimulated with ImmunoCult in the presence of vehicle (control) for 4 days before FACS sorting into CFSE-low (proliferating) and CFSE-high (non-proliferating) populations for sgRNA sequencing.
study_title: Genome-wide CRISPR Screens in Primary Human T Cells Reveal Key Regulators of Immune Function

screen_title: Secondary pooled CRISPR-Cas9 screen for positive regulators of TH2 cell differentiation (IL-13 reporter expression) in mouse primary CD4+ T cells
dirconv: positive foldchange indicates sgRNA enrichment in the IL-13Tom+ (TH2-differentiated) population, i.e. a positive regulator of TH2 cell differentiation

sel: FACS sorting of transduced cells into IL-13-tdTomato-positive and -negative populations as a surrogate for TH2 differentiation
stim: anti-CD3/anti-CD28 with IL-2, then TH2 polarization with IL-4 and anti-IFN-gamma
cult: RPMI-1640 medium, 10% FCS, penicillin-streptomycin and 2-mercaptoethanol; TH2 polarization with IL-2 (10 ng/ml) and IL-4 (10 ng/ml)
harvest: 3 d after TH2 differentiation induction (day 9 of culture)

study_title: An αvβ3 integrin checkpoint is critical for efficient TH2 cell cytokine polarization and potentiation of antigen-specific immunity

screen_title: Guide Swap pooled CRISPR-Cas9 depletion and enrichment screen in human primary CD4+ T cells
dirconv: positive log2 fold change indicates gRNA enrichment in the CD45-negative population relative to day 0, i.e. loss of CD45 surface expression upon target knockout
phdesc: Enrichment of lenti vector-encoded gRNAs in the day 6 RFP+CD45- sorted population relative to day 0, identifying genes regulating CD45 (PTPRC) surface expression; effect is the maximal log2 fold change (Day 6 CD45- vs. Day 0)
sel: FACS sorting for loss of CD45 surface expression (day 6 CD45- population versus day 0)
cult: RPMI 1640 + 10% FBS + 5 mM HEPES + 1% PSG + 1x MEM NEAA + 1 mM sodium pyruvate + 20 U/mL IL-2 + 1x BME
adesc: Activated CD4+ T cells were transduced with a ~13,000 gRNA pooled library (day -2), incubated 48h, a day 0 sample was removed, remaining cells were electroporated with nontargeting Cas9 RNP (Guide Swap) to deliver Cas9, cultured 6 days, then FACS-sorted into cells that lost CD45 surface expression (RFP+CD45-) versus day 0; gRNA abundance was compared by NGS.
study_title: Guide Swap enables genome-scale pooled CRISPR–Cas9 screening in human primary cells

screen_title: Guide Swap pooled CRISPR-Cas9 depletion and enrichment screen in human primary CD4+ T cells
dirconv: enrichment of a gRNA in the CD4- population indicates the target gene regulates CD4 surface expression
phdesc: gRNA enrichment in the day 6 RFP+CD4- population (cells that lost CD4 surface expression) relative to day 0, cells separated by FACS staining for CD4
sel: FACS sorting for loss of CD4 surface expression (day 6 CD4- population versus day 0)
cult: RPMI 1640 + 10% FBS + 5 mM HEPES + 1% PSG + 1x MEM NEAA + 1 mM sodium pyruvate + 20 U/ml IL-2 + 1x BME
adesc: Activated CD4+ T cells were transduced with a pooled lentiviral gRNA library (~13,000 gRNAs, 2,585 genes) on the day of thaw; 48 h later a day 0 sample was taken and remaining cells were electroporated with nontargeting Cas9 RNP (Guide Swap). Six days after nucleofection cells were stained and FACS-sorted; for this readout the RFP+CD4- population was compared with the day 0 sample by NGS of encoded gRNA abundance.
study_title: Guide Swap enables genome-scale pooled CRISPR–Cas9 screening in human primary cells

screen_title: Guide Swap pooled CRISPR-Cas9 depletion and enrichment screen in human primary CD4+ T cells
dirconv: positive log2 fold change (CXCR4-/day 0) indicates gRNA enrichment in the CXCR4-negative population, i.e. gene knockout reduces CXCR4 surface expression
phdesc: Enrichment of lenti vector-encoded gRNAs in the day 6 RFP+CXCR4- sorted population relative to day 0, identifying genes that regulate CXCR4 surface expression
sel: FACS sorting for cells that lost CXCR4 surface expression (day 6 CXCR4- population) relative to day 0
cult: RPMI 1640 + 10% FBS + 5 mM HEPES + 1% PSG + 1x MEM NEAA + 1 mM sodium pyruvate + 20 U/mL IL-2 + 1x BME, with Dynabeads Human T-Activator CD3/28
adesc: Activated CD4+ T cells were transduced with a pooled lentiviral gRNA library (~13,000 gRNAs, 2,585 genes, ~5 gRNAs/gene plus spike-in gRNAs for CD4/CD45/CXCR4), incubated 48h, sampled at day 0, then electroporated with nontargeting Cas9 RNP (Guide Swap). Six days after nucleofection, cells were sorted by FACS into CXCR4- and retained-marker populations and gRNA abundance compared to day 0 by NGS.
study_title: Guide Swap enables genome-scale pooled CRISPR–Cas9 screening in human primary cells

screen_title: Guide Swap pooled CRISPR-Cas9 depletion and enrichment screen in human primary CD4+ T cells
dirconv: The reported statistic is -log2 fold change (max); positive values indicate depletion of the gRNA in the day 6 retained population relative to day 0, i.e. the target gene is required for fitness
phdesc: Depletion of gRNA abundance in the day 6 population retaining CD4+CD45+CXCR4+ surface markers relative to the day 0 sample, quantified as maximal log2 fold change and RSA per gene; depleted guides indicate genes required for T cell fitness/survival
sel: 6-day in vitro expansion culture; guides depleted from the retained CD4+CD45+CXCR4+ population relative to the day 0 sample reflect fitness/essentiality (dropout)
cult: RPMI 1640 + 10% FBS + 5 mM HEPES + 1% PSG + 1x MEM NEAA + 1 mM sodium pyruvate + 20 U/mL IL-2 + 1x BME
adesc: Activated CD4+ T cells were transduced with a ~13,000-guide lentiviral gRNA library (day -2), incubated 48h to allow gRNA expression, then a day 0 sample was reserved and remaining cells electroporated with nontargeting Cas9 RNP (Guide Swap) to deliver Cas9. After 6 days of culture, cells were FACS-sorted; for this readout the retained CD4+CD45+CXCR4+ population was compared with the day 0 sample and guide abundance quantified by NGS.
study_title: Guide Swap enables genome-scale pooled CRISPR–Cas9 screening in human primary cells

screen_title: CRISPRn TF knockout screen for trans-regulators of FOXP3 in human Treg cells
dirconv: gRNAs enriched in the FOXP3-low bin (negative pos|lfc direction) indicate positive regulators of FOXP3; gRNAs enriched in the FOXP3-high bin indicate negative regulators
phdesc: Intracellular FOXP3 staining measured by flow cytometry; cells sorted into FOXP3-high (top ~25%) and FOXP3-low (bottom ~25%) bins, gRNA enrichment quantified between bins in human Treg cells
sel: FACS sorting into high and low FOXP3 expression bins (top and bottom 25%)
cult: X-VIVO15 + 5% FBS + 55 uM 2-Mercaptoethanol + 4 mM N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine + 200 IU/mL IL-2
adesc: Primary human Treg cells were stimulated with anti-CD3/CD28 beads, infected with the TF/chromatin/immune-gene gRNA library via lentivirus 24h post-stimulation, and received Cas9 RNP via electroporation 72h post-stimulation. Nine days post-stimulation cells were restimulated with CD3/CD28 beads, and 48h post-restimulation cells were FACS-sorted into FOXP3-high and FOXP3-low bins for gRNA enrichment analysis.
study_title: FOXP3 expression depends on cell-type-specific cis-regulatory elements and transcription factor circuitry

screen_title: CRISPRn TF knockout screen for trans-regulators of FOXP3 in human Tconv cells
dirconv: gRNAs enriched in the FOXP3-low bin indicate positive regulators of FOXP3; gRNAs enriched in the FOXP3-high bin indicate negative regulators
phdesc: Intracellular FOXP3 protein levels measured in stimulated primary human Tconv cells; cells sorted by FACS into FOXP3-high (top ~25%) and FOXP3-low (bottom ~25%) bins, gRNA enrichment quantified between bins
sel: FACS sorting into high and low FOXP3 expression bins
cult: X-VIVO15 + 5% FBS + 55 uM 2-mercaptoethanol + 4 mM N-acetyl-L-cysteine + 200 IU/mL IL-2
adesc: Tconv cells were stimulated with CD3/CD28 Dynabeads, transduced with the TF gRNA library lentivirus 24h post-stimulation, electroporated with Cas9 RNP 72h post-stimulation, expanded, restimulated with CD3/CD28 beads at day 9, and 48h post-restimulation sorted by FACS into FOXP3-high and FOXP3-low bins for gRNA enrichment sequencing
study_title: FOXP3 expression depends on cell-type-specific cis-regulatory elements and transcription factor circuitry

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR-KO screen in IL13Ra2-CAR T cells (donor 1)
dirconv: positive beta-value indicates guide enrichment (increased CAR T-cell abundance/fitness) in coculture relative to Time 0; negative indicates depletion
phdesc: MAGeCK beta-value for guide abundance in CAR T cells after coculture with PBT030-2 GSCs relative to Time 0, quantifying guide enrichment/depletion (proliferation/fitness) during tumor coculture
sel: repetitive co-culture (rechallenge) with IL13Ra2+ PBT030-2 GSC tumor cells at high tumor burden to induce CAR T-cell exhaustion
stim: co-culture with PBT030-2 GSCs (IL13Ra2+ tumor cells)
cult: X-VIVO 15 containing 10% FBS, 50 U/mL rhIL2, and 0.5 ng/mL rhIL15

Genomic DNA was isolated from these cells and compared with CAR T cells harvested before coculture (Time 0). This co-culture vs. Time 0 comparison was used to identify/exclude guides depleted after 72-hour coculture with GSCs.
study_title: CRISPR Screening of CAR T Cells and Cancer Stem Cells

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR-KO screen in IL13Ra2-CAR T cells (donor 2)
dirconv: positive beta-value indicates guide enrichment (increased CAR T-cell abundance) in coculture relative to Time 0; negative indicates depletion
phdesc: MAGECK beta-value for guide abundance in CAR T cells after coculture with GSCs compared with Time 0, used to detect guides depleted/enriched during tumor coculture

study_title: CRISPR Screening of CAR T Cells and Cancer Stem Cells

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR-KO screen in IL13Ra2-CAR T cells (donor 1)
dirconv: negative beta-value indicates depletion over time (impaired proliferation/viability); positive beta-value indicates enrichment
phdesc: MAGeCK beta-value of sgRNA/gene abundance in CAR T cells after 72-hour monoculture compared with Time 0, capturing genes whose knockout affects CAR T-cell proliferation or viability in the absence of tumor
sel: 72-hour monoculture of CAR T cells with no tumor challenge; comparison to input (Time 0) captures guide dropout/fitness in culture
cult: X-VIVO 15 containing 10% FBS, 50 U/mL recombinant human IL2 (rhIL2), and 0.5 ng/mL rhIL15
adesc: IL13Ra2-CAR T cells were co-transduced with the Brunello sgRNA library and the CAR construct and electroporated with Cas9 protein; for this readout, CRISPR-edited CAR T cells were cultured in monoculture for 72 hours and their genomic DNA compared with CAR T cells harvested before coculture (Time 0) to identify guides depleted/enriched in monoculture.
study_title: CRISPR Screening of CAR T Cells and Cancer Stem Cells

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR-KO screen in IL13Ra2-CAR T cells (donor 2)
dirconv: Negative beta-value indicates guide depletion relative to Time 0 (gene knockout impairs CAR T-cell proliferation/viability); sgRNAs depleted at beta < -1 were excluded
phdesc: MAGeCK beta-value comparing sgRNA abundance in CAR T cells after 72-hour monoculture versus Time 0, reflecting guide dropout/enrichment as a measure of T-cell fitness/proliferation
sel: CAR T cells cultured alone (monoculture) for 72 hours to identify guides depleted through impaired proliferation or viability
cult: X-VIVO 15 containing 10% FBS, 50 U/mL rhIL2, and 0.5 ng/mL rhIL15
adesc: This readout compares CAR T cells (donor 2) harboring CRISPR knockouts after 72 hours of monoculture (cultured alone, no tumor challenge) versus Time 0, serving as a control to exclude guides that nonspecifically impaired CAR T-cell proliferation or viability.
study_title: CRISPR Screening of CAR T Cells and Cancer Stem Cells

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR-KO screen in IL13Ra2-CAR T cells (donor 1)

CAR T cells were sorted into PD-1-negative and PD-1-positive fractions and sequenced separately to identify enriched/depleted guides.
study_title: CRISPR Screening of CAR T Cells and Cancer Stem Cells

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR-KO screen in IL13Ra2-CAR T cells (donor 2)
dirconv: Positive value indicates enrichment in the less-exhausted PD-1-negative compartment relative to the PD-1-positive compartment
phdesc: CAR T cells (CD45+, IL13+) sorted into PD-1-positive versus PD-1-negative compartments after tumor rechallenge; effect compares guide abundance in the less-exhausted PD-1-negative versus more-exhausted PD-1-positive subset
sel: Recursive co-culture with PBT030-2 GSCs (E:T 1:4, then GSC rechallenge at 48h) to induce CAR T-cell exhaustion, followed by FACS sorting of less-exhausted PD-1-negative versus more-exhausted PD-1-positive CAR T cells
stim: Co-culture with PBT030-2 GSCs (IL13Ra2+ tumor cells) with GSC rechallenge
cult: X-VIVO 15 containing 10% FBS, 50 U/mL rhIL2, and 0.5 ng/mL rhIL15
adesc: CAR T cells transduced with CAR and the CRISPR-KO library were cocultured with PBT030-2 GSCs at E:T 1:4 in Matrigel-coated plates; after 48 hours CAR T cells were rechallenged by doubling the number of GSCs; 24 hours after rechallenge the coculture was harvested, stained for CD45, PD-1, and IL13, and CAR T cells sorted into total, PD-1-positive, and PD-1-negative subsets for sgRNA sequencing
study_title: CRISPR Screening of CAR T Cells and Cancer Stem Cells

screen_title: In vivo pooled CRISPR-Cas9 screen of metabolism genes in OT-I CD8+ T cells (tumor-infiltrating enrichment)

study_title: Targeting Regnase-1 programs long-lived effector T cells for cancer therapy

screen_title: Secondary genome-scale Brie CRISPR-Cas9 screen in Regnase-1-null OT-I CD8+ T cells (tumor-infiltrating enrichment)
dirconv: positive log2 ratio (TIL/input) indicates sgRNA enrichment, i.e. increased accumulation of the mutant cells in tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes

study_title: Targeting Regnase-1 programs long-lived effector T cells for cancer therapy

screen_title: In vivo AAV-SB-CRISPR membrane-proteome (Surf) knockout screen in Cas9 CD8+ T cells in a syngeneic GL261 glioblastoma model (gene-level RIGER)

study_title: In vivo CRISPR screening in CD8 T cells with AAV-Sleeping Beauty hybrid vectors identifies membrane targets for improving immunotherapy for glioblastoma

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR knockout fitness screen for CD8 T cell expansion in vitro

study_name: Genome-wide fitness gene identification reveals Roquin as a potent suppressor of CD8 T cell expansion and anti-tumor immunity

screen_title: Genome-wide CRISPR knockout fitness screen for CD8 T cell expansion in vivo

study_name: Genome-wide fitness gene identification reveals Roquin as a potent suppressor of CD8 T cell expansion and anti-tumor immunity
